links.outcome: Readability grade level of ADRD information from GenAI chatbots
links.effect: ADRD information from GenAI chatbots, especially treatment information, had college-level readability, exceeding recommended reading levels for patient education materials.
links.quote: Our sample of ADRD GenAI information exceeded recommended reading levels for patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluated the readability and linguistic characteristics of Alzheimer's disease health information generated by LLM chatbots without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
